cohort: Preterm infants <32 weeks gestation in the Australian and New Zealand Neonatal Network (ANZNN) from 1995 to 2012
finding: Along with increased survival among infants born <32 weeks gestation, the incidence of severe IVH has decreased over the 18 years, especially in the most recent period.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of severe IVH (AOR 1.4, 95% CI 1.3 to 1.6).
